_schema: Generated by render_actions.js from ACTIONS.json — do not hand-edit. One row per action: [id, surface]. The agent-facing table of contents: hold this in context, fetch full entries by id via tools/session/actions_query.js. No urgency/importance here — the live AI scores those at decision time.
actions: No UI. SEAM-ONLY: this verb has NO player-facing press. A grep of src/ui for it returns nothing — BL-350 landed the procurement seam, its world state, its serialisation and its harness, but no UI. It is reachable ONLY through the corp-command seam: an out-of-process agent via ProjectIo --serve / the MCP server's issue_command, or a harness. The rival scorer does not emit it either (corp_ai.cpp enumerates no procurement candidate). Recorded rather than omitted, because an entry that says 'no human can press this, you can' is exactly the information a language policy needs — and because omitting it is how this dictionary fell four verbs behind the enum it transcribes.
Tile construction ledger (fold-out column), opened from the Selection band of a selected tile; a shortcut lives on a selected owned building ('Build another here').

Since BL-293 the press is not the only route: place_sell_order is a corp_verb, so an agent issues it directly against the corp-command seam and a rival corp's scorer issues it too.
The 'Remove' button beside each listed order on the Market Ledger's Sell Orders tab; also a corp_verb, issuable directly.

The 'Auto' checkbox beside the band's workforce slider; the 'Auto (N%)' button above the panel's tier grid. Also a corp_verb.
The Survey section of the Selection band when an unsurveyed body is selected (the hero action for that selection kind; the star carries no survey).
